```toml
[versions]

unaffected = []
```

# Fabricated advisory used only by cargo-upkeep's analyzer tests

This advisory does not exist. `serde` is not affected by anything described
here.

It is here so analyzer tests can prove vulnerability mapping against the local
fixture database without fetching the shared `~/.cargo/advisory-db`. No real
advisory database contains this ID.

The year 2099 keeps the ID clear of anything the RustSec project will allocate,
and `patched = [">= 9999.0.0"]` makes every real `serde` release match.
